name: 胰十二指肠切除 / Whipple

patient_notice_en: Demonstration case using an existing random-pool patient; her ordinary case data is unchanged.

steps.name: 主要血管关系与切除路径评估
steps.name_en: Assess major vessels and resection route

options.label: 按既定路线确认关键结构
options.label_en: Confirm key structures along the planned route
options.description: 保持既定节奏，完成重点暴露与止血确认。
options.description_en: Maintain the planned pace and confirm targeted exposure and haemostasis.

options.label: 扩大暴露后再次核对血管关系
options.label_en: Expand exposure and recheck vascular relationships
options.description: 多用10分钟，获得更清楚的术野并进一步控制出血。
options.description_en: Spend 10 more minutes improving visibility and controlling bleeding.

steps.name: 胰头深部精细分离
steps.name_en: Deep precision dissection of the pancreatic head

options.label: 重点复核吻合口与活动性出血
options.label_en: Focus on anastomoses and active bleeding
options.description: 完成重点检查并处理可见出血点。
options.description_en: Complete targeted checks and address visible bleeding.

options.label: 系统复核全术野与各处重建
options.label_en: Systematically review the field and all reconstructions
options.description: 多用10分钟，扩大复核范围并充分整理术野。
options.description_en: Spend 10 more minutes on a wider review and field preparation.

name: 盆壁肿瘤切除（髂血管重建）
name_en: Pelvic sidewall tumour resection with iliac vascular reconstruction
patient_notice: 演示病例，使用随机池患者形象；不改变其普通病例资料。
patient_notice_en: Demonstration case using an existing random-pool patient; her ordinary case data is unchanged.

steps.name: 神经与输尿管邻近关系辨认
steps.name_en: Identify relations to nerves and ureter

options.label: 按既定血管路径确认切除范围
options.label_en: Confirm resection along the planned vascular route
options.description: 按照已确认的血管关系推进，保持手术节奏。
options.description_en: Proceed along the confirmed vascular anatomy without extending the operative time.

options.label: 扩大暴露并复核髂血管走行
options.label_en: Expand exposure and reassess iliac vessels
options.description: 额外花费10分钟，充分检查复杂的血管交界区域。
options.description_en: Spend 10 additional minutes reviewing the complex vascular interfaces.

steps.name: 盆壁神经与固定点复核
steps.name_en: Review pelvic nerves and fixation points

options.label: 重点复核重建血管与出血点
options.label_en: Review reconstructed vessels and bleeding points
options.description: 检查血流恢复情况，处理可见出血。
options.description_en: Check restored flow and address visible bleeding.

options.label: 延长灌注观察与盆壁止血复核
options.label_en: Extend perfusion observation and pelvic haemostasis review
options.description: 额外花费10分钟扩大检查范围。
options.description_en: Spend 10 additional minutes on a broader review.

name: 开胸袖式肺叶切除
patient_notice: 演示病例，使用随机池患者形象；不改变其普通病例资料。本演示病例需要血管重建。
patient_notice_en: Demonstration case using an existing random-pool patient; her ordinary case data is unchanged. This demonstration case requires vascular reconstruction.

options.label: 按既定肺叶与支气管边界推进
options.label_en: Proceed along the planned lobar and bronchial boundaries
options.description: 复核支气管切缘与需保留的结构。
options.description_en: Recheck bronchial margins and the structures to preserve.

options.label: 扩大肺门暴露并再次核对切缘
options.label_en: Expand hilar exposure and reassess margins
options.description: 额外花费10分钟核对肺动脉、支气管的空间关系。
options.description_en: Spend 10 additional minutes reviewing the pulmonary artery and bronchial anatomy.

options.label: 重点核对支气管通气与血管灌注
options.label_en: Check bronchial ventilation and vascular perfusion
options.description: 完成重点检查并处理出血点。
options.description_en: Complete focused checks and address visible bleeding.

options.label: 延长通气测试与重建区检查
options.label_en: Extend ventilation testing and reconstruction review
options.description: 额外花费10分钟，复核吻合口及重建血管。
options.description_en: Spend 10 additional minutes reviewing the anastomosis and reconstructed vessels.

name: Ebstein 畸形三尖瓣 Cone 重建术
name_en: Cone reconstruction of the tricuspid valve for Ebstein anomaly
patient_notice: 演示病例，使用随机池患者形象；不改变其普通病例资料。本术式包含体外循环和三尖瓣 Cone 重建。
patient_notice_en: Demonstration case using an existing random-pool patient; her ordinary case data is unchanged. This procedure includes cardiopulmonary bypass and cone reconstruction of the tricuspid valve.

steps.name: 建立体外循环与右心房暴露
steps.name_en: Establish cardiopulmonary bypass and expose the right atrium

steps.name: 后叶及隔叶组织游离
steps.name_en: Mobilize posterior and septal leaflet tissue

steps.name: 可用瓣叶组织与重建路径评估
steps.name_en: Assess leaflet tissue and the reconstruction plan

options.label: 按已游离瓣叶范围规划 Cone
options.label_en: Plan the cone with the mobilized leaflet tissue
options.description: 以当前可用瓣叶组织确定重建方向。
options.description_en: Determine the reconstruction route using the leaflet tissue assessed so far.

options.label: 扩大瓣叶评估并再次核对瓣环
options.label_en: Extend leaflet assessment and reassess the annulus
options.description: 额外花费10分钟，确认瓣叶活动度与瓣环对应关系。
options.description_en: Spend 10 additional minutes reviewing leaflet mobility and the annular anatomy.

steps.name: 旋转瓣叶、构建 Cone
steps.name_en: Rotate mobilized leaflets to form a cone

steps.name: 心房化右室折叠与瓣环调整
steps.name_en: Plicate the atrialized right ventricle and adjust the annulus

steps.name: Cone 于解剖瓣环重新附着
steps.name_en: Reattach the cone at the anatomical annulus

steps.name: 瓣叶对合试验与精细修正
steps.name_en: Test leaflet coaptation and make fine adjustments

steps.name: 右心房整理与关闭
steps.name_en: Complete right atrial repair and closure

steps.name: 脱离体外循环、功能评估
steps.name_en: Wean from bypass and assess valve function

options.label: 重点评估三尖瓣对合与循环
options.label_en: Assess tricuspid coaptation and circulation
options.description: 围绕瓣膜功能和循环状态进行重点复核。
options.description_en: Perform focused checks of valve function and circulation.

options.label: 延长功能评估与止血复核
options.label_en: Extend functional assessment and haemostasis review
options.description: 额外花费10分钟，扩大对合及术野复核范围。
options.description_en: Spend 10 additional minutes on a broader review of coaptation and the operative field.

name: 开腹复杂腹腔黏连松解及多脏器修复重建术
name_en: Open complex abdominal adhesiolysis and multiorgan preservation-reconstruction
patient_notice: 随机返场病例：既往复杂腹部损伤及症状相关黏连，拟行限定范围的器官保留性修复。
patient_notice_en: Repeat case: complex old abdominal injury with symptomatic adhesions requiring targeted organ-preserving repair.

steps.name: 旧瘢痕评估与谨慎开腹
steps.name_en: Assess old scars and enter abdomen cautiously

steps.name: 幸存器官与黏连区地图
腹壁与肠袢致密黏连的安全分离
steps.name_en: Safely separate adhesions between abdominal wall and bowel

steps.name: 目标性松解范围判断
steps.name_en: Determine the scope of targeted adhesiolysis

options.label: 选择目标性松解范围
options.label_en: Limit dissection to symptomatic adhesions
options.description: 只松解造成症状且已确认血供的牵拉区域。
options.description_en: Release only symptom-producing adhesions after checking their blood supply.

options.label: 延长侧支血供评估
options.label_en: Extend mapping of collateral circulation
options.description: 额外花费10分钟梳理侧支血管走行，再限定松解范围。
options.description_en: Spend 10 extra minutes mapping collateral vessels before targeted adhesiolysis.

steps.name: 脆弱肠壁周围的精细松解
steps.name_en: Precision dissection around fragile bowel wall

steps.name: 肠系膜侧支血管辨认与保护
steps.name_en: Identify and preserve mesenteric collateral vessels

steps.name: 残存消化道局部修补与重建
steps.name_en: Repair and reconstruct the preserved digestive tract

steps.name: 局部供血路径松解与稳定化
steps.name_en: Release and stabilize regional blood supply

steps.name: 修补部位张力与连续性复核
steps.name_en: Review repair integrity and suture tension

steps.name: 血供、渗漏与止血总复核

options.label: 完整复查血供与修补线
options.label_en: Review perfusion and bowel repair integrity
options.description: 检查灌注、修补区连续性与已处理的出血点。
options.description_en: Check perfusion, repair integrity and bleeding sites.

options.label: 延长灌注与渗漏观察
options.label_en: Extend perfusion and leakage monitoring
options.description: 额外花费10分钟进一步复核吻合张力与小范围渗漏。
options.description_en: Spend 10 extra minutes reassessing repair tension and subtle leakage.

name: 开胸降主动脉瘤切除及人工血管置换术
name_en: Open descending thoracic aortic aneurysm resection and prosthetic graft replacement
patient_notice: 随机返场病例：胸段降主动脉瘤，拟行左开胸血管置换及必要灌注保护。
patient_notice_en: Repeat case: descending thoracic aortic aneurysm requiring left thoracotomy, graft replacement and perfusion protection.

steps.name: 胸段降主动脉与邻近结构辨认
steps.name_en: Identify descending thoracic aorta and adjacent structures

steps.name: 近远端安全控制区精细分离
steps.name_en: Dissect safe proximal and distal control zones

steps.name: 远端灌注与脊髓保护方案确认
steps.name_en: Confirm distal perfusion and spinal cord protection plan

options.label: 确认远端灌注准备就绪
options.label_en: Confirm distal perfusion support
options.description: 确认左心旁路、脊髓供血保护与监测项目已就绪。
options.description_en: Confirm left-heart bypass, spinal cord protection and monitoring.

options.label: 延长灌注与夹闭方案复核
options.label_en: Extend perfusion and clamp-plan review
options.description: 额外花费10分钟复核主动脉两端控制点与灌注路线。
options.description_en: Spend 10 more minutes reassessing clamp sites and the distal perfusion path.

steps.name: 主动脉控制与分阶段夹闭
steps.name_en: Secure aortic control and sequential clamping

steps.name: 病变血管段处理与人工血管准备
steps.name_en: Manage diseased aortic segment and prepare prosthetic graft

steps.name: 人工血管近端精细吻合
重要肋间动脉血供保护与重接
steps.name_en: Preserve and reattach critical intercostal arteries

steps.name: 人工血管远端精细吻合
分阶段复灌与吻合区止血处理
远端脉搏、脊髓保护与最终复核
steps.name_en: Review distal pulses and spinal cord protection

options.label: 按计划复核远端灌注
options.label_en: Review distal perfusion as planned
options.description: 检查移植物吻合口、远端灌注与关键神经监测。
options.description_en: Review graft joins, distal perfusion and key neurological monitoring.

options.label: 延长脊髓灌注及止血复查
options.label_en: Extend spinal perfusion and hemostasis review
options.description: 额外花费10分钟延长观察并逐处复查高风险吻合位置。
options.description_en: Spend 10 more minutes observing perfusion and inspecting higher-risk suture lines.

name: 复杂创伤后胸腰椎后凸矫正、椎体切除及内固定融合术
name_en: Complex Post-traumatic Thoracolumbar Kyphosis Correction with Posterior Vertebral Column Resection and Instrumented Fusion
patient_notice: 随机返场病例：陈旧胸腰椎骨折后固定性后凸，拟行后路椎体切除、前柱支撑与内固定融合。
patient_notice_en: Repeat case: fixed kyphosis following an old thoracolumbar fracture, planned for posterior vertebral column resection, anterior column support and instrumented fusion.

steps.name: 全麻俯卧定位与神经监测基线
截骨前保护与暂时固定策略
steps.name_en: Neural Protection and Temporary Fixation Strategy

options.label: 分侧固定与充分神经释放
options.label_en: Alternate fixation sides with thorough neural release
options.description: 按计划先稳定一侧、分段释放后交换临时棒；更多显露和操作时间，降低后续突发失稳风险。
options.description_en: Stabilize one side first, release in stages, then exchange the temporary rod. More exposure and time reduce the risk of sudden loss of stability.

options.label: 有限暴露下顺序交换临时棒
options.label_en: Exchange temporary rods in sequence with limited exposure
options.description: 在当前影像认可范围内减少额外暴露，节省时间，但需要更仔细地监视临时支撑与后续操作区；语义效果：elapsed_time 较少、下一阶段 visibility 可能较低。不是“省掉安全固定直接截骨”。
options.description_en: Reduce additional exposure within the imaging-approved area to save time, while monitoring temporary support and the next operative area more closely. This does not omit safe fixation before osteotomy.

steps.name: 椎板减压及硬膜神经保护
前柱支撑与矫形幅度规划

options.label: 分段复位、逐次核对
options.label_en: Correct in stages with repeated checks
options.description: 按术前矫形目标逐步恢复前柱支撑和后方排列，复核更多；增加时间，减少一次性牵拉负担。
options.description_en: Restore anterior support and posterior alignment toward the preoperative correction target in stages, with more checks and time to reduce one-step traction.

options.label: 集中完成计划内复位
options.label_en: Complete the planned correction in a focused sequence
options.description: 在已确认支撑充分的前提下减少棒的反复调整，减少耗时，但操作更依赖精确对合，后续 Stability/Visibility 的压力较高。
options.description_en: With adequate support confirmed, reduce repeated rod adjustments and time, at the cost of greater dependence on precise alignment and later stability and visibility.

steps.name: 渐进式后凸矫正与连接棒复位
steps.name_en: Gradual Kyphosis Reduction and Rod Seating

steps.name: 最终固定、植骨及完整性复查
steps.name_en: Final Fixation, Grafting and Integrity Check
